about: Choices made at /admin/numbers on the English deck's unsure number words (src/features/vocabulary/lib/worded-numbers.ts). number: the words were written as digits; word: they stay words. Keyed by card, field and the words around the number. scripts/scan-worded-numbers.ts --apply writes the number choices again after a re-import.
